thread:
Aisha (AE): Quick heads-up 2:30 PT. Prospect requests a BYOK HSM POC that must demonstrate a zero-downtime key rotation and a documented failover path. They're also asking for a clear pricing delta vs standard Dedicated.
Ben (SalesEng): Will do. Need to break pricing into: one-time connector engineering, monthly HSM ops, per-crypto-op surcharge, and optional long-term audit retention (they asked about 3 years). Also they want line-item for rotation rehearsals.
Tao (SRE): Technical constraints: if keys never leave customer HSM (pure bridge) our crypto latency adds RTT + signing time. For sim we need vendor/model (e.g., Thales Luna, AWS CloudHSM) and expected per-op durations. For 100 TPS we might need a batching proxy or ephemeral wrapping to avoid per-request HSM roundtrips.
Lena (Security): Security checklist: hardware attestation cert, signed provenance on key import events, immutable rotation audit trail, and SIEM forwarding (syslog or signed S3 bundles). Incident notification SLA <=2h. Also require proof of reproducible dry-run (replayable audit).
Aisha (AE): They specified hybrid topology: on-prem primary HSM with async mirror to our Dedicated for DR. They want to see an automated demo that switches to mirrored key with <5m RTO and no failed requests. Is that achievable?
Tao (SRE): Auto-switch needs ephemeral delegation and a short TTL wrapping key to avoid rekeying on every request. We can do it but it raises custody discussions. Manual operator-driven failover is safer but adds minutes to RTO.
Ben (SalesEng): For the SOW acceptance tests propose these four items: 1) successful encrypt/decrypt using bridged keys for 60 minutes, 2) scripted rotation dry-run with zero 5xx for a 30m window, 3) throughput test hitting 100 TPS with <75ms extra crypto latency, 4) delivery of signed audit bundle to customer S3 on each rotation.
Lena (Security): Audit bundle must include key_id, prev_key_fingerprint, rotation_timestamp, actor_cert_thumbprint, and an HMAC-signed manifest. Retention proof for 3 years required. Add clause: customer owns CMK; we provide audit copies only.
Aisha (AE): Contracts asked for non-standard clauses: key custody indemnity, liability cap for customer hardware failures, and defined rotation rehearsal schedule. contracts-bot, flag anything missing?
contracts-bot: Flagged: need a clause limiting liability for failures of customer-managed HSM hardware, and explicit acceptance criteria tied to test harness results. Recommend milestone-based payments: 30% on connector completion, 40% on POC acceptance, remainder on production cutover.
Tao (SRE): Sample command for rotation dry-run we can include in runbook (staging):
```
./hsm-dryrun --env=staging --hsm-endpoint=vpn://10.0.4.2:443 --key=svc-prod-01 --mode=simulate --verify-manifest --profile=100tps
```
This will produce a signed bundle at ./out/rotation-<ts>.tar.gz.
Ben (SalesEng): I'll draft three pricing bands: Connector-only (customer handles rotation), Assisted-rotate (we run automation + monthly ops), Fully-managed (we proxy keys, extended retention). Include estimated monthly ops hours and an ops-oncall line.
Lena (Security): Also request vendor attestation docs (HW cert chain) before any POC. We'll require a one-time security review sign-off.
ci-cd-bot: Uploaded preliminary SOW and runbook: https://redwood.internal/sow/1717778888-poc-hsm-demo  Please review.
Aisha (AE): Thanks. Ben, can you send initial pricing sketch + SOW bullets by EOD? Tao, run a latency sim Thu morning and share results. Lena, prepare security Q answers for the customer's questionnaire. We'll converge tomorrow. :thumbsup:
